zones.name: Enchanted Forest
zones.description: A lush, vibrant forest, teeming with life. Sunlight filters through the canopy, illuminating a path teeming with strange and wonderful creatures.

zones.name: Sunken Ruins
zones.description: The crumbling remains of an ancient city, now submerged in a murky swamp. The air is thick with the smell of decay, and strange creatures lurk beneath the surface.

zones.name: Haunted Mines
zones.description: An abandoned mine shaft, said to be haunted by the ghosts of miners who died in a tragic accident. The only light comes from glowing fungi and the occasional spectral apparition.

zones.name: Scorched Plains
zones.description: A barren wasteland of cracked earth and volcanic rock. The air shimmers with heat, and rivers of lava flow like fiery serpents across the landscape.

zones.name: Frozen Wastes
zones.description: A vast, icy tundra, where the wind howls like a hungry wolf. The snow is deep, and the only landmarks are towering glaciers and the frozen remains of long-dead creatures.

zones.name: Forgotten Desert
zones.description: A vast, sun-drenched desert, where ancient ruins lie buried beneath the sand. The heat is oppressive, and mirages dance on the horizon.

zones.name: Whispering Forest
zones.description: A dense, ancient forest, where the trees whisper secrets to one another. The air is thick with magic, and strange creatures of myth and legend make their home here.

zones.name: Abyssal Depths
zones.description: A dark, underwater realm, where the pressure is immense and sunlight cannot penetrate. Strange, bioluminescent creatures light the way, and ancient horrors lurk in the darkness.

zones.name: Ironforge
zones.description: A bustling, subterranean city of dwarves and gnomes. The air is thick with the smell of smoke and steel, and the sound of hammers ringing on anvils is a constant refrain.

zones.name: Outland
zones.description: The shattered remains of a once-beautiful world, now floating in the Twisting Nether. The sky is a swirling vortex of color, and the ground is a patchwork of alien landscapes.

zones.name: Shadowfen
zones.description: A dark and treacherous swamp, where the water is black and still. The air is thick with the buzz of insects, and the trees are draped in curtains of moss.

zones.name: Crystal Caves
zones.description: A network of shimmering caves, where the walls are lined with crystals of every color. The air is cool and still, and the only sound is the gentle drip of water.

zones.name: Dragonblight
zones.description: A vast, frozen wasteland, littered with the bones of ancient dragons. The sky is a perpetual twilight, and the wind whispers tales of a long-forgotten war.

zones.name: Un'Goro Crater
zones.description: A lush, prehistoric jungle, filled with giant dinosaurs and strange, alien life. The air is thick with the smell of flowers and decay, and the ground in constant tremor.

zones.name: Silithus
zones.description: A barren, insect-infested desert, where giant crystalline structures jut out of the sand. The air is thick with the buzz of insects, and the ground is crawling with alien life.

zones.name: Blackrock Mountain
zones.description: A massive, volcanic mountain, carved into a fortress by the Dark Iron dwarves. The air is thick with smoke and ash, and the mountain rumbles with the sound of a thousand forges.

zones.name: Outland - Hellfire Peninsula
zones.description: The shattered remains of a once-beautiful world, now a demonic wasteland. The sky is a swirling vortex of fel energy, and the ground is a patchwork of red rock and demonic citadels.

zones.name: Northrend - Icecrown Citadel
zones.description: A vast, frozen continent, ruled by the Lich King. The sky is a perpetual winter, and the land is covered in a thick blanket of snow and ice.

zones.name: Pandaria - Vale of Eternal Blossoms
zones.description: A hidden, mystical land, shrouded in mist. The land is a patchwork of lush forests, towering mountains, and serene valleys.

zones.name: Draenor - Tanaan Jungle
zones.description: A savage, untamed world, where orcs and draenei clash in a brutal war. The land is a patchwork of lush jungles, arid deserts, and jagged mountains.
